title: cesium3d tiles writer
explanation:
### Description

Write 3D Tiles from OBJ and CityGML buildings, then import and render the church model.

**dataset → input → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkCesium3DTilesWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCesium3DTilesWriter.html) — cesium3d tiles writer.
- [vtkCityGMLReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCityGMLReader.html) — city gml reader.
- [vtkFieldData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFieldData.html) — field data.
- [vtkGLTFImporter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGLTFImporter.html) — gltf importer.
- [vtkMultiBlockDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMultiBlockDataSet.html) — groups multiple datasets into a composite structure.
- [vtkOBJReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOBJReader.html) — obj reader.
- [vtkStringArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringArray.html) — string array.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
